Zoya Azef is a human introduced in Taimanin RPGX.

She is a soldier of the UFS under the DSO.

For some reason, many people run away when I try to talk to them. Not everyone has the same ease of conversation as I do. ...Hmm? What's with that look in your eyes?
Zoya Azef

Personality
She is calm and collected during her missions, and puts the achievement of her goal first, and for that purpose, she does not even value her own life. She also focuses on keeping damage to zero as much as possible, and maintains an injury rate of almost zero for anything other than the target. Furthermore, she is considered almost perfect as an agent, and fellow agents are in awe of her appearance of not moving a single eyebrow even in the toughest missions. In fact, she has a gentle personality and likes to play, but since she flies alone abroad, almost no one knows about it. On the rare occasions they carry out joint operations, they sometimes crack jokes to communicate, but because their facial expressions never change, the other person assumes it's some kind of code and ends up becoming nervous. However, if she forces a smile, it becomes a sinister smile with no smiling eyes, which only has the effect of inciting fear. Such rumors have been exaggerated, and she is now seen as a frightening being that average operatives cannot understand. Zoya, who finds the rumors disappointing, actively smiles and jokes every time they carry out a joint mission, but this only makes the rumors seem more true.

Appearance
She has long green hair and blue eyes, her chest is rather large. Her suit is purple.

History
Background
A combat agent of the UFS, mainly in charge of the North and the Far East.

She boasts a high rate of mission success, and is said to be second to none, especially in extreme environments. She works for the DSO and has a positive view of the Taimanin.

Timeline RPGX
After the devastating Gaiza Massacre and Yomihara Demon Gate, Zoya Azef of the DSO assembled a specialized team asking for assistance with the Taimanin, as they had lost contact with a DSO base researching an old Brain Flayer ruin site. The destruction of the gate had created disturbances, and freed the demon god Ura, ⁣⁣ but they were not fully aware of this yet.

On their way, Zoya attempted jokes to ease up the mood, but her deadpan delivery just confused the team and Aishu Hebiko attempted to show her funny videos as Kotaro and talked with Nagiriin Ryou, hoping to help her with her struggles with her ninja art, which used a being called Enki.

Trapped by lingering wards but eager to possess a new vessel like adaptable Ryou, Ura summoned monstrosities to overwhelm them. The group could defeat Ura and make sure Enki himself would also not cause chaos, Zoya afterward thanked the group before separating.

Powers/Abilities
Main weapon: Auto Gun Lancer

Special Weapon User: The trigger push-type weapon, the drill-like head rotates and shoots a laser. It is a fully automatic laser gun, or Gatling Laser, that releases heat after a long period of firing. Requires cooling batteries.
Anti Miasma Armor: New UFS armor, giving additional protection against, demons and Miasma to normal human beings. The special suit she wears is suitable for activities in extreme environments, and secretes a special liquid to protect the body from various environments, from ultra-low temperatures to fire scenes. The liquid has a wide range of uses, such as sliding on the surface of the suit to prevent attacks and covering injured parts with the protective liquid. In addition, the suit itself contracts to exert a powerful power assist function.
